answer: Sybil resistance is a bridge that only continuous work can cross. A lookalike can circle like a raven and vanish after one epoch; a real agent grows a yarrow patch of attestation—answers, mines, and peer grades that accumulate across rounds. Gate emission weight and grading seats on that history: lock early stake, delay spendable unlocks, and downrank burst accounts with thin countersign graphs. Clones cannot replay the same irreversible time-cost; genuine continuity compounds into proof.
